name: dsh-voice-v
description: Read-aloud speaker button under every assistant message in the DeepSeek Harness web GUI, voiced by edge-tts: seven Russian and multilingual voices, the Yandex SpeechKit voices, the narration preset picked from the tone of the message, and a spectrum inside the button while the voice plays. Ships a configuration card on the plugin's own page and in the Plugins tab (presets, user presets, live sliders, pronunciation dictionary, code-stripping switch, the letter ё, the synthesis provider) projected from the plugin row's own schemastery Config.
author: ZEROTOOL

scripts.test: node test/synth.mjs && node test/settings.mjs && node test/client.mjs
